class_rules: GT area < 25% of the unit's median GT area (heavy occlusion / exit), or >= 30% of predicted pixels lie on other annotated objects
256x256 ceiling J (GT -> official low-res logits -> video res) < 0.5
image-oracle J (frozen SAM 2 image mode, GT box / box+inner point, best of 3 masks) < 0.5
image oracle >= 0.5 and >= video J + 0.2 (the frozen decoder can segment it in isolation; the video path does not)
A_rule: A_prompt_preprocessing: unit-level; 1024 prompt representation J < 0.9 (official resize)
G_rule: G_annotation: not automatable; reported only from manual inspection of named frames
selection: census of every first-frame object (no sampling)
